tools.name: shell
tools.description: Execute SOLARIS commands for pathway analysis, pangenomic comparison, and compatibility prediction

value.description: The SOLARIS command to execute (e.g., 'python -m solaris pathway_profiler workflow --genome file.fasta --pfam-db /path/to/pfam')

examples: solaris pathway_profiler workflow --pathway map00720 --genome genome.fasta --pfam-db ./pfam --output-dir results

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask a follow-up question to the user for clarification

value.description: The question to ask the user

tools.name: end
tools.description: End the conversation or complete the current task

pathway_profiler.description: EC-based pathway profiling and genome analysis

pangenomic_analyzer.description: Multi-strain pangenomic comparison and chassis selection

compatibility_predictor.description: Enzyme-host compatibility scoring and organism matching
